name: streakwise
description: A convenience tool for multitaskers: track several goals, courses, and projects side by side with streaks, a heatmap, weekly targets, shareable reports, and a Claude (MCP) connection.

paragraphs: A convenience tool for multitaskers. Juggle courses, projects, and goals side by side in one place: log time in a few taps, see where your hours go, keep a streak alive, share clean reports, and let Claude log sessions and analyse your progress for you.
Live app: streakwise-ap.netlify.app · Try it without an account: demo mode
🚧 Active development. Core features are live. A final polish pass is next (see Roadmap).
features: Organise goals as tracks → subtasks → topics (e.g. Exam Prep → Practice, or
School Subjects → Maths → Chapter 3), each track with its own colour.
Log a session in a few taps: pick what you studied, tap a duration, add an optional note.
Mark topics not started, in progress, or done and watch your syllabus percentage grow.
Home dashboard: today's time, current and longest streak, weekly targets with progress bars,
